note: Hand-curated TRL/MRL assessments. Every record carries `src` as its assessment basis - AD-052: a readiness level with no stated basis is an opinion. Edit this file, not the database.

technologies.name: X-Band Transponders
technologies.description: Standard NASA/DoD deep-space and military comms. Decades of heritage.

technologies.name: Ka-Band High-Throughput Satellite
technologies.description: High-capacity broadband payload. Operational across multiple constellations.

technologies.name: Optical / Laser Communications Terminal
technologies.description: LCRD, LLCD, TBIRD flight-demonstrated. Commercial terminals in early production.

technologies.name: Software-Defined Radio (space)
technologies.description: Reconfigurable payload with on-orbit waveform updates. Production established.

technologies.name: Phased Array Antennas (active)
technologies.description: Electronically steered antennas for LEO constellations. Rapidly maturing.

technologies.name: Quantum Key Distribution (space)
technologies.description: Chinese Micius demonstrated QKD. Western programs in early development.

technologies.name: Inter-Satellite Link — Optical
technologies.description: Laser crosslinks for constellation backbone. Starlink Gen 2, Tesat LCT.

technologies.name: Crewed Lunar Lander (HLS)
technologies.description: SpaceX Starship HLS, Blue Origin. Subsystem tests underway.

technologies.name: In-Situ Resource Utilization (ISRU)
technologies.description: MOXIE on Perseverance demonstrated O2 from CO2. Regolith systems early stage.

technologies.name: Cryogenic Propellant Storage (long-duration)
technologies.description: Zero-boiloff storage not yet demonstrated in space.

technologies.name: EVA Suit — xEMU / AxEMU
technologies.description: Next-gen Moon/Mars EVA suits. Design mature; production qualification ongoing.

technologies.name: Star Trackers
technologies.description: Optical attitude sensors on virtually all spacecraft. Commoditized.

technologies.name: Ring Laser Gyroscopes
technologies.description: High-accuracy inertial navigation. Multiple qualified suppliers.

technologies.name: MEMS IMUs (space-grade)
technologies.description: Miniaturized IMUs enabling smallsat GNC. Rad-hardened variants in production.

technologies.name: Reaction Wheels
technologies.description: Standard attitude control. Multiple sizes from CubeSat to GEO.

technologies.name: Autonomous Rendezvous & Docking
technologies.description: Dragon, HTV, Cygnus heritage. Commercial products emerging.

technologies.name: AI-Based GNC / Onboard ML
technologies.description: ML for autonomous navigation and fault detection. Limited flight qualification.

technologies.name: Terrain Relative Navigation
technologies.description: Mars 2020 TRN flight-demonstrated. Lunar variant for Artemis in development.

technologies.name: Hypersonic Glide Vehicle
technologies.description: Multiple nations flight-tested. US LRHW and CPS in development.

technologies.name: Scramjet Propulsion
technologies.description: X-51A Waverider demonstrated. No operational engines in production.

technologies.name: Ultra-High-Temperature Ceramics (UHTC)
technologies.description: HfB2/ZrB2 for leading edges >2000°C. Manufacturing scale limited.

technologies.name: LOX/LH2 Cryogenic Engines
technologies.description: RS-25, Vulcain, RL-10 class engines. Highest-performance chemical propulsion.

technologies.name: LOX/Kerosene (RP-1) Engines
technologies.description: Merlin, RD-180, F-1 class. Dense storable propellants, extensive heritage.

technologies.name: Solid Rocket Boosters
technologies.description: High-thrust solid motors. Reliable and simple across many launch vehicles.

technologies.name: LOX/Methane Engines
technologies.description: Raptor, BE-4, Prometheus. Flight-demonstrated; full reusability still maturing.

technologies.name: Nuclear Thermal Propulsion
technologies.description: NERVA heritage; modern designs at component phase. No recent flight demo.

technologies.name: Air-Breathing Combined Cycle (TBCC/RBCC)
technologies.description: Turbine/rocket combined cycle for reusable first stages. Component demos; integrated system unflown.

technologies.name: On-Orbit Servicing — Life Extension
technologies.description: Northrop MEV-1/MEV-2 operationally flown. Servicer production limited.

technologies.name: Active Debris Removal
technologies.description: ESA ClearSpace-1, Astroscale ELSA-d. Flight demos imminent.

technologies.name: On-Orbit Refueling
technologies.description: OSAM-1/Restore-L. ISS RRM demos; full autonomous mission not flown.

technologies.name: In-Space Manufacturing
technologies.description: Fabrication in microgravity. ISS experiments done; useful production rates not achieved.

technologies.name: CubeSats (1U–6U)
technologies.description: Standardized smallsats. Fully commoditized ecosystem.

technologies.name: SmallSats (6–500 kg)
technologies.description: Commercial bus platforms. Volume production ramping with constellation demand.

technologies.name: GEO Communications Bus
technologies.description: Boeing 702, Airbus Eurostar, SSL 1300. Fully mature; decades of heritage.

technologies.name: LEO Broadband Constellation Satellite
technologies.description: Mass-produced flat-panel LEO satellites. Starlink, OneWeb, Kuiper.

technologies.name: Triple-Junction GaAs Solar Arrays
technologies.description: >30% efficiency cells. Dominates commercial and government satellites.

technologies.name: Flexible Rollout Solar Arrays (ROSA)
technologies.description: Lightweight arrays deployed on ISS and Gateway. Supply chain developing.

technologies.name: Lithium-Ion Batteries (space-grade)
technologies.description: Standard energy storage. Custom qualification adds cost vs. commercial cells.

technologies.name: RTG (Radioisotope Thermoelectric Generator)
technologies.description: Pu-238 generators for deep-space missions. Limited by Pu-238 supply chain.

technologies.name: Fission Surface Power (Kilopower/KRUSTY)
technologies.description: KRUSTY nuclear demo complete. Full power system not yet built or tested.

technologies.name: Perovskite Solar Cells (space)
technologies.description: Emerging high-efficiency PV. Radiation tolerance and qualification in progress.

technologies.name: Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR)
technologies.description: Sentinel-1, Radarsat, NovaSAR operational. Small SAR satellites in production.

technologies.name: Electro-Optical / IR Imagers
technologies.description: Sub-meter commercial imagers in volume production.

technologies.name: Hyperspectral Imagers (space)
technologies.description: DESIS, PRISMA, EnMAP operational. Lower-cost commercial units emerging.

technologies.name: Space-Based LIDAR
technologies.description: ICESat-2, GEDI scientifically operational. Smaller tactical lidar maturing.

technologies.name: GNSS-Reflectometry (GNSS-R)
technologies.description: CYGNSS operational. Smallsat products entering market.

technologies.name: Quantum Sensing / Gravimetry (space)
technologies.description: Atom interferometry. Ground demos excellent; space-hardened systems not qualified.

technologies.name: Propulsive Vertical Landing
technologies.description: Falcon 9 operationally demonstrated. Starship Super Heavy qualifying.

technologies.name: Supersonic Retropropulsion
technologies.description: Mars 2020 partial demo. Large-scale Mars Human Landing in development.

technologies.name: HIAD Inflatable Reentry Decelerator
technologies.description: Subscale orbital tests flown. Full-scale system not yet demonstrated.

technologies.name: Supersonic Parachutes (planetary)
technologies.description: MSL, Mars 2020, InSight flight-qualified. LOFTID Earth demo 2022.

technologies.name: Carbon Fiber Reinforced Polymer (CFRP)
technologies.description: Primary structural material for fairings, buses, and booms.

technologies.name: Additively Manufactured Metal Structures
technologies.description: 3D-printed Ti/Inconel brackets. Flight-proven; qualification maturing.

technologies.name: PICA Ablative Heat Shield
technologies.description: Used on Dragon, Stardust, MSL. High-heritage; manufacturing established.

technologies.name: High-Temperature CMC
technologies.description: SiC/SiC ceramic matrix composites for nozzle liners and TPS.

technologies.name: Self-Healing Composites
technologies.description: Micro-vascular networks for autonomous repair. Lab demonstrations only.

technologies.name: Aerogel Insulation (space)
technologies.description: Ultra-low thermal conductivity for cryogenic tanks and landers.

technologies.name: Hydrazine Monopropellant Thrusters
technologies.description: Standard attitude/orbit control on thousands of satellites.

technologies.name: Bipropellant (MMH/NTO) Systems
technologies.description: High-Isp chemical propulsion for GEO insertion and large maneuvers.

technologies.name: Hall Effect Thrusters
technologies.description: High-efficiency xenon ion propulsion (PPS-1350, SPT-100). In production; scaling limited.

technologies.name: Gridded Ion Engines
technologies.description: Very high Isp electric propulsion. Dawn, Deep Space 1 flight heritage.

technologies.name: Green Monopropellant (AF-M315E)
technologies.description: Low-toxicity hydrazine alternative. STP-2, GPIM flight-demonstrated.

technologies.name: Cold Gas Thrusters
technologies.description: Simplest propulsion. Widely used on cubesats and inspection vehicles.

technologies.name: Electrospray / FEEP Thrusters
technologies.description: Ultra-precise micro-Newton thrusters. LISA Pathfinder demo; limited production.

technologies.name: Solar Sail Propulsion
technologies.description: LightSail 2 and IKAROS demonstrated controlled solar sailing.

technologies.name: Heat Pipes (spacecraft)
technologies.description: Passive two-phase thermal transport. Ubiquitous; multiple manufacturers.

technologies.name: Loop Heat Pipes
technologies.description: Advanced passive thermal devices. Used on many LEO/GEO satellites.

technologies.name: Deployable Radiators
technologies.description: Foldout radiators for high-power payloads. ISS ETCS is heritage.

technologies.name: Two-Phase Mechanically Pumped Loop
technologies.description: Higher-efficiency active thermal control. Ground and parabolic demos.
